Stannous Fluoride Fluoruro estañoso; Stannosi Fluoridum. Tin fluoride. SnF2 = 156.7. CAS — 7783-47-3. ATC — A01AA04. ATC Vet — QA01AA04. Pharmacopoeias. In US. USP 31 (Stannous Fluoride). A white crystalline powder. Freely soluble in water; practically insoluble in alcohol, in chloroform, and in ether. pH of a freshly prepared 0.4% solution in water is between 2.8 and 3.5. Stability. Aqueous solutions of stannous fluoride decompose within a few hours with the formation of a white precipitate; they slowly attack glass. Profile Stannous fluoride is used as a source of fluoride (see Sodium Fluoride, p.1962) for the prophylaxis of dental caries. Dental gels containing concentrations of stannous fluoride 0.4% are availa- ble for daily use. Higher concentrations have been applied under professional supervision. Stannous fluoride has also been used in dentifrices and mouth rinses. Stannous fluoride has an unpleasant taste. Preparations USP 31: Stannous Fluoride Gel.
